name: hide-details
title: Hide Details
description: Redact names, emails, cards, secrets, and faces in a screenshot before you share. On-device.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: redact-clipboard
commands.title: Redact Clipboard Image
commands.subtitle: Hide Details
commands.description: Find sensitive details in the clipboard image and copy a redacted version

commands.name: redact-now
commands.title: Redact and Copy
commands.subtitle: Hide Details
commands.description: Redact the clipboard image immediately and copy it back

preferences.name: showOCRConfidence
preferences.title: OCR Confidence
preferences.label: Show OCR Confidence
preferences.description: Show text recognition confidence percentages in the detection list.

preferences.name: recognition
preferences.title: Text Recognition
preferences.description: Fast works well for clear screenshots. Accurate can help with small or difficult text, but takes longer to start.

preferences.name: style
preferences.title: Redaction Style
preferences.description: Blackout covers detected regions. Blur and pixelation obscure them but can retain readable information.

preferences.name: categories
preferences.title: What to Hide
preferences.description: Comma-separated: email, phone, card, secret, ip, name, face. Leave empty to use only Custom Regex.

preferences.name: extraWords
preferences.title: Always Hide These Words
preferences.description: Comma-separated names or strings to redact. Keep the name category enabled to use this list.

preferences.name: customRegex
preferences.title: Custom Regex
preferences.description: Optional pattern applied to each OCR line. Combine patterns with | and use (?i) for case-insensitive matching. Enter the pattern without / delimiters.

preferences.name: padding
preferences.title: Padding
preferences.description: Extra pixels around each detection. Enter a number from 0 to 1000.
